interpretation.hypothesis: The observed real semifinal error reflects relation confusion that also occurs with unfamiliar entities and other event domains.
interpretation.contrasts: Counterbalance candidate identity, target passage order, target-only evidence and missing-target evidence. Twelve family/world cells, four families; the 96 prompts are not 96 independent tasks.
interpretation.qualification: At least three family/world cells across at least two families have a wrong supported answer, while at least 22/24 target-only outputs have correct answer content. Report missing-target and order effects separately. This is development headroom only, not trained benefit.
interpretation.review: Read all full outputs, credit semantically correct names with possessives/explanations; flag truncation. No substring-only score. Distinguish distractor selection, unsupported answer, abstention and other error.
interpretation.limits: Templates were designed after seeing one tennis failure. No fresh confirmation or natural distribution claim. If solved, do not keep increasing noise until a failure appears. No automatic training follows.
